WCAG Accessibility Audit - Quick Reference

Overview

  • Total Issues Found: 13
  • Critical: 4 | Major: 5 | Minor: 4
  • Estimated Fix Time: 2.5-3 hours
  • Current Status: Partially Compliant (needs WCAG AA remediation)

Critical Issues (Fix First)

1. Link Hover Color Contrast

  • File: /assets/main.scss:69
  • Issue: #e17055 on #f2e9dc = 2.63:1 (needs 4.5:1)
  • Fix: Change to #c45827 or #d64045 (5.2:1 or 4.8:1)
  • Time: 10 minutes

2. Warning Color Insufficient Contrast

  • File: /assets/main.scss:14
  • Issue: #f39c12 on white = 2.19:1 (needs 4.5:1)
  • Fix: Change to #856404 or #664d03 (6.47:1 or 8.1:1)
  • Time: 5 minutes

3. Missing Alt Text on Blog Images

  • Files: Multiple blog posts (5+ images)
  • Issue: Critical diagrams/photos have no alt text
  • Priority: BID framework diagram (bid-framework.png)
  • Time: 30 minutes

4. Subscribe Button Missing Focus Indicator

  • File: /assets/main.scss:440-459
  • Issue: No :focus styling (only :hover)
  • Fix: Add :focus and :focus-visible rules
  • Time: 5 minutes

  • Time: 5 minutes

Form HTML Fix

Current (Broken):

<form class="email-subscription-form" action="#" method="post">
  <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Enter your email" required>
  <button type="submit" class="subscribe-btn">Subscribe</button>
</form>

Fixed:

<form class="email-subscription-form" action="#" method="post">
  <label for="email-input" class="visually-hidden">Email address</label>
  <input type="email" id="email-input" name="email" 
         placeholder="Enter your email" required 
         aria-describedby="email-note">
  <button type="submit" class="subscribe-btn">Subscribe</button>
  <p id="email-note" class="subscription-note">No spam, ever...</p>
</form>

Add to SCSS:

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0;
  margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
  white-space: nowrap; border-width: 0;
}

.email-subscription-form .subscribe-btn {
  &:focus {
    outline: 3px solid $primary;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}
